prompt: I'm deciding whether to quit my job to flip furniture full-time. Run it through at least five of the nine models in The Great Mental Models, Vol. 1.
assertions: Applies at least five named models
Uses second-order thinking with concrete consequences
Uses inversion (e.g. what would guarantee failure)
Uses circle of competence and/or probabilistic thinking with numbers
Ends with a decision rule or test, not just a list
